stage: accepted T5 executable source; no T6 implementation yet

capabilities.description: Read, list and write files inside approved project roots and Host-owned mission workspaces.

cost.note: Local disk I/O; no model tokens.

actions.description: Read a UTF-8 text file (up to 1 MB).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: File path, relative to the step's working folder.

actions.evidence: Absolute path and byte count read from disk.

actions.description: List a folder (up to 500 entries).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Folder path; defaults to the working folder.

actions.description: Check whether a path exists.
Write a UTF-8 text file atomically (temporary file + rename).

inputs.name: overwrite
inputs.description: Allow replacing an existing file (default false).

actions.evidence: Path and bytes written, read back from disk.

actions.description: Delete one file (never a folder).
actions.evidence: Path no longer exists on disk.

limitations: Root/junction and private Host state checks already enforced.

capabilities.description: Git status, diff, log, commit, isolated worktrees and merge through the local git executable.

cost.note: Local git; no network (push is not offered).

actions.description: Branch and porcelain status.
Diff stat and patch (working tree vs HEAD, or against a ref).
actions.evidence: Patch stored as an artifact with its SHA-256.

actions.description: Recent commits (one line each).
Stage all changes in the folder and commit with a message.
Create an isolated worktree on a new bunny/* branch under the Host data folder.
Remove a clean Bunny-owned worktree (never one outside the Host data folder).
Merge a bunny/* branch into the current branch (--no-ff; aborts cleanly on conflict).

limitations: Agent delegation permits status/diff/log; broad project scripts and Git mutations unsupported.

capabilities.description: Run one executable with an argument list (no shell) inside an approved folder.

cost.note: Local CPU only; no model tokens.

actions.description: Run `command args…` without a shell. npm/npx run through this Node's npm CLI; .cmd/.bat/.ps1 scripts are refused.

inputs.name: cwd
inputs.description: Working folder inside the approved roots.

actions.outputs: { command, args, cwd, exitCode, stdout, stderr, durationMs, timedOut }
actions.evidence: Exact argv, folder, exit code and output tail.

limitations: Agent delegation permits exact immutable pure-read Node checks only.

capabilities.description: Isolated Bunny-owned browser profile for research and web tasks (Playwright over installed Chromium/Chrome/Edge).

cost.note: Local browser process; network traffic to visited sites; no model tokens.

actions.description: Open a public http(s) URL in a Bunny tab.
actions.evidence: Final URL, title and HTTP status.

actions.description: Search the web (DuckDuckGo HTML) and return result links.
actions.evidence: Search URL, retrieval time and result list (research note artifact).

actions.description: Read the current page's visible text (bounded) with URL/title evidence.
actions.evidence: browser_evidence artifact: URL, title, retrieval time, text excerpt.

actions.description: Extract text or an attribute from elements matching a CSS selector.
Page title, canonical URL, description and Open Graph metadata.
Click an element found by role+name, label, text or CSS selector.
actions.evidence: Locator used and URL after the click.

actions.description: Fill a form field found by label, placeholder or selector; optional Enter.
actions.evidence: Locator used (typed text is not logged).

actions.description: Wait for a selector, text or load state.
Screenshot the current tab into the mission's artifacts.
Download a public URL (or the file a click starts) into the Host artifacts folder.

inputs.name: selector
inputs.description: Element whose click starts the download.

actions.description: List, open or close Bunny tabs.

limitations: Shared Bunny-owned profile, no Mission origin/session binding in T5 delegation.

capabilities.description: Windows desktop control through UI Automation and user32 (semantic controls, no coordinates).

cost.note: Local PowerShell/UI Automation; no model tokens.

actions.description: List top-level windows (pid, process, title, foreground).
actions.evidence: Window list at the time of the call.

actions.description: Semantic control tree of one window (name, type, automation id).
Bring a window to the foreground.
Invoke/toggle/select/expand a named control via UI Automation.
actions.evidence: Control identity, the matched top-level window's owning pid and the pattern used.

actions.description: Set the value of an editable control via the UI Automation ValuePattern (not keystrokes).
actions.evidence: The matched top-level window's owning pid, value length before/after and whether it matches.

actions.description: Capture the whole virtual screen to a PNG artifact.
Start an allowlisted application (notepad, calculator, paint, explorer, terminal), optionally on a non-executable file inside an approved root.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: File or folder inside an approved root.

actions.evidence: Started process id and new window count.

actions.description: Read only the arithmetic result of the verified Microsoft Calculator application.
actions.evidence: Verified Calculator result, no other controls.

limitations: Specific T9/T9R Calculator approval; broad Agent desktop grant unsupported.

missingBoundaries: Cross-app exact-operation consent derived from canonical plan
Canonical artifact input references and verified postconditions
Capability replay facts and correlated safe Agent UI activity
